summary: Security & Settings page reorganization and live record count fixes completed. Top row desktop layout now features a 3-column grid (Admin Credentials, Session Monitor, and System Audit Trail). Institutional Backup & Recovery Center and Institutional Data Purge & Reset are now positioned together at the bottom. Layout overflow bug fixed by removing extraneous closing div. Live record counts for all 9 categories now update accurately in real-time with Firestore.
